rationale: This mutation bridges the $10,999 cash deficit by inverting the liquidation hierarchy—elevating Oracle Frontrun to Priority 3 and tightening routine liquidation to Priority 4 with a >=1.00x base price floor (dropping to 0.90x only at 60% shed occupancy)—eliminating the 15-40% margin leakage of premature fire-sales. It enforces Strawberry Acreage Sovereignty by dedicating 10-11 plots to permanent, hyper-fertilized Strawberry compounding with 2-3 isolated auxiliary plots for town shop demands, while enacting realistic seed phase-gates (halting Pumpkins Day 21, Tomatoes Day 24, Carrots Day 27) and purging phantom wheat reserves when livestock is zero. Furthermore, it synchronizes early land scaling (8-10 plots at hands >= 5, capping strictly at 12-14 plots by Day 14) and re-sequences farm execution (Cluster Harvest -> Immediate Shed Deposit -> Water Dry Plots -> Apply Fertilizer -> Plant) to unlock early Strawberry harvest cycles and eliminate worker transit waste.
